subject: Re: RepSession step list and installed test
body: Yes, mode=anchor-only is the installed test (D-reps-003, proposed to human). I've adopted your names (mode, endedBy, trigger.detectionId, steps[].completed). Step kinds a rep logs, in order: anchor, physiology, focus, leverage (inside the focus budget, only if the profile has one), language, peak (stack all three + anchor again = the conditioning pairing), rate. Rate-before and rate-after are both kind 'rate'. Anchor-only logs: rate, anchor, rate. Please add: kind 'peak'; endedBy 'user-stop'; steps[].plannedMs; plus anchorPaired, recoveryCensored, signalSource (simulator|hr-strap|none), scriptHash, repIndex, profileId, startedAt/endedAt on the session. A sham has steps=[] apart from the rate steps.
